scenarios.name: delirium-three-graveyard-card-types-is-short
scenarios.why: The graveyard holds a creature, an artifact, and an instant, which are only three distinct card types; a land must also be present to reach four.

scenarios.name: delirium-four-graveyard-card-types-copy-creature
scenarios.why: Creature, artifact, instant, and land cards in the graveyard supply four different card types; the activation can copy the creature card there until end of turn.
